name: brandwright
description: On-brand UI mock-ups from a brand's own websites: capture the sites (crawl with your own login, or feed screenshots), read design tokens and component styles into brand.css, train a brand LoRA plus sub-site LoRAs that learn only what each site adds (ostris ai-toolkit; Z-Image, Qwen-Image-2512, FLUX.2 klein), and generate mock-ups in ComfyUI, with a training-free reference route and a code route for pixel-exact components. Evergreen.
